autocompact.pick.placeholder: One value applies to every model: a 200K-window model caps it at 200K. Costs are API-equivalent at list prices ({date}), assuming a warm cache, about 3K new tokens per call and about 30K left after compacting.
autocompact.pick.placeholder.codex: Codex reads model_auto_compact_token_limit from config.toml; it can only lower the default 90%. Costs are API-equivalent at list prices ({date}).
autocompact.info.official.label: Claude Code recommends auto: “Overriding auto may result in high token usage, especially when resuming long sessions.”
autocompact.info.official: Claude Code says: “The auto setting picks a window tuned for your model and is strongly recommended for the best cost and performance. Overriding auto may result in high token usage, especially when resuming long sessions.” It doesn't explain why. Likely reasons: resuming an old session that is already bigger than the new window compacts it right away, with an expired cache; a window too close to your startup context (CLAUDE.md, tools, memory) makes it compact again and again; and details lost in a summary make the model re-read files.
autocompact.info.reminder: The more often it compacts, the more details are lost. Put long-term rules in CLAUDE.md; for a new task, a new session works better than compacting.
autocompact.info.env: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW is set. It overrides any value set here.
autocompact.info.off: Auto-compact is turned off (autoCompactEnabled: false). A value set here takes effect only after you turn it back on with /config.
autocompact.info.small: This model has a 200K window. Lowering the threshold saves little here (Research saves about {pct} per call), so only Research is offered, for quality.
autocompact.info.small.noPrice: This model has a 200K window. Lowering the threshold saves little here, so only Research is offered, for quality.

autocompact.tooltip: Claude Code compacts about 33K tokens before the window you set (estimated from the official ≈ 967K on 1M-window models). One value applies to every model; a 200K-window model caps it at 200K. Agent Monitor can't see Claude Code's environment: if CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW or CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE is set there, it compacts at a different point.
autocompact.tooltip.codex: Codex compacts at 90% of the window by default; model_auto_compact_token_limit in config.toml can only lower it.
